copy.header: Trades in these stocks by members of the House of Representatives, from the periodic transaction reports they file with the Clerk.
copy.footer: Members have up to 45 days to report a trade and some take longer, so the filed date matters as much as the traded one. Amounts are the bands the form offers, not figures. Senators are not covered: the Senate publishes no file to read. Reports filed on paper are scanned images and are not read. Not a signal.
